[[Ceremonial Daggers (unique)|Ceremonial Daggers]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] traded by [[Adept of Shadows]], a [[collector]] who can be found in [[Divine Path]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30
